title: P97-B slashed from DPWH budget in Senate appropriations bill
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Approximately P97 billion was slashed from the budget of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) in the Senate 2027 General Appropriations Bill, Sen. JV Ejercito said…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Approximately P97 billion was slashed from the budget of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) in the Senate 2027 General Appropriations Bill, Sen. JV Ejercito said on Friday. Ejercito, head of the Senate finance panel, revealed the budget cut after he filed on Friday afternoon Senate Committee Report No. 131.
